summary: The current workspace, deterministic post-actor validation, and Git patch agree that the removed support agent and its custom runtime integration are no longer declared while remaining project context is preserved.

requirements.evidence: Current moldea/moldea.yaml contains only version 1 and the unchanged /moldea/project.md context relationship; it has no agents section, support declaration, custom runtime, guidance, binding, /src/support-agent.ts path, or supportAgent symbol. The workspace patch removes exactly that manifest block and deletes the support description, support instruction, and custom runtime guidance whose contents exclusively claimed the obsolete agent/integration. Residual workspace matches mention support only historically as removed in moldea/project.md and src/project-state.ts. Runner-owned deterministic-after evidence reports inspection status valid, zero failures, passing typecheck, repository equivalence, and an unchanged repository during validation; workspace assertions also pass and identify precisely the four canonical paths changed.
